svg.title: How an order's status changes
svg.desc: An order starts in_progress. From there it is delivered or shipped; it ends rejected, expired or cancelled with nothing charged; it becomes unfulfilled when it was paid and not delivered in time, refused after the charge, or you left; it becomes delivered_unpaid when a synchronous charge failed after your delivery; and it becomes payment_unresolved when nobody heard whether the charge went through. A late delivery takes an unfulfilled order to delivered or shipped, and a buyer paying again takes a delivered_unpaid order to delivered. A payment_unresolved order moves once the payment is known: paid takes a synchronous order to delivered and an order paid at purchase to unfulfilled, and not paid takes a synchronous order to delivered_unpaid and an order paid at purchase to rejected. A delivered_unpaid order whose new charge goes unanswered becomes payment_unresolved. You can close fulfillment of an order that is in_progress, unfulfilled or delivered_unpaid, which makes it fulfillment_closed; closing a payment_unresolved order keeps that word until the payment is known, and then it reads fulfillment_closed.
